mapper.sql: SELECT R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, R.USER_ID AS userId, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE AS ownerStatusCode, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID
SELECT MESSAGE_ID AS messageId, ROOM_ID AS roomId, SENDER_USER_ID AS senderUserId, SENDER_TYPE_CODE AS senderTypeCode, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM CHAT_MESSAGE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (USER_ID, LAST_MESSAGE_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (ROOM_ID, SENDER_USER_ID, SENDER_TYPE_CODE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderUserId}, #{senderTypeCode}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: (SELECT MAX(M.MESSAGE_ID) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND M.MESSAGE_ID <= #{lastMessageId})
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET USER_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID = WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND USER_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID <
UPDATE CHAT_ROOM SET ADMIN_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID = WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND ADMIN_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID <
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.MESSAGE_ID > R.USER_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.SENDER_TYPE_CODE = 'ADMIN'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.MESSAGE_ID > R.ADMIN_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID WHERE M.SENDER_TYPE_CODE = 'USER'

SELECT R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, CASE WHEN U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN '탈퇴한 회원' ELSE U.NICKNAME END AS nickname, M.CONTENT AS lastMessage, R.LAST_MESSAGE_AT AS lastMessageAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE N WHERE N.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND N.SENDER_TYPE_CODE = 'USER' AND N.MESSAGE_ID > R.ADMIN_LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID) AS unreadCount FROM CHAT_ROOM R JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID JOIN (SELECT ROOM_ID, MAX(MESSAGE_ID) AS LAST_MESSAGE_ID FROM CHAT_MESSAGE GROUP BY ROOM_ID) L ON L.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON M.MESSAGE_ID = L.LAST_MESSAGE_ID ORDER BY R.LAST_MESSAGE_AT DESC, R.ROOM_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
